messages:
jamal: PR ready for staging but blocked on approvals — https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5421 needs LGTM. CODEOWNERS points at `/services/model/ -> @ml-team` but this touches deploy config. who can approve?
sasha: AFAIK infra-deployment stuff usually needs eng-platform or eng-infra. tagging @kevin @liz to confirm.
kevin: I can take a look. If CODEOWNERS maps to @ml-team we normally require ml signoff. Is this just a docker tag + rollout cfg? can you paste the diff?
liz: It's a small k8s manifest tweak + rollout policy. I'd accept if an ml-owner signs or if we use an infra-override route. CI looks green though.
ops-bot: CI status — ✅ all checks passed; deploy-staging job succeeded.
sandeep: We have a short-circuit: if the PR body includes `#infra-override` and one eng-platform lead lgtm, staging deploy allowed. Follow-up required to move infra parts under a proper infra-owned path.
jamal: Added `#infra-override` to the PR description and pinged @sasha for signoff. plan to deploy in ~30m unless anyone objects.
sasha: Reviewed quickly — tests & diff look safe. LGTM :+1:
kevin: thanks. I'll wait 15m for other approvers then merge.
liz: ok from infra side as well. leaving a comment to request a follow-up ticket to relocate manifests to `/deploy/`.
jamal: will file the follow-up issue after merge. thanks everyone :pray:
